page.layout: One printed page, shown upside down on the scan. Central title block within a decorative woodcut border: large capitals at top, centred title lines below, a printer's device (emblem) in the centre with vertical side lines, and the imprint with place and date at the foot. Border ornament on all four sides.
page.notes: Whole page is upside down, so the lines were read by rotating the image 180 degrees. The scan is low contrast and the title block is faint, so most lines are doubtful: the words marked [?] and the illegible lines should be checked against the original. The vertical lines on either side of the emblem and the lines of the border ornament could not be read and were left out. The emblem is a printer's device with a winged figure and serpents; it is not text. The imprint line and the date at the foot are the least certain readings. Heavy brown water stains and a torn hole at the lower centre cover parts of the lines, which accounts for most of the illegible passages. The page has no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
